page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance features 40 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, providing a 1:1 mapping of vCPUs to physical cores. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.8 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and delivering a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Benchmark data places the ecs.hfg6.10xlarge in the average performance tier across multiple tests. In CPU-focused workloads, the instance achieved a stress-ng single-core score of 1438.99 and a multi-core score of 38378.07, alongside a Geekbench multi-core score of 12045.0. Memory bandwidth tests recorded 108.89 GB/sec for large-block read operations and 48.09 GB/sec for large-block write operations. For specialized tasks, the server demonstrated a static web serving throughput of 25.35 GB/sec and processed 34.78 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks. Large language model inference speeds reached 12.71 tokens per second for text generation using a medium 7B model.

From a resource density perspective, the dedicated core allocation ensures consistent CPU performance without virtualization-induced noisy neighbor effects, though the lack of local NVMe storage requires external storage solutions which may introduce latency tradeoffs. The 1:4.8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offers a balanced hardware profile suitable for memory-conscious compute workloads. This configuration is appropriate for database operations, software compilation, web serving, and moderate-scale text or image processing tasks.
